demos.name: GridDemo
demos.description: In this Demo the horizontal grid is customized with some CSS selectors.

demos.name: GridLabels
demos.description: Setting position: 'none' also frees the space, but the axis is then removed from the chart, and the yAxis slot is no longer rendered.

demos.name: TickNumber
demos.description: In the demo below, the top axis has a tickMinStep of half a day, and the bottom axis has a tickMinStep of a full day.

demos.name: TickSpacing
demos.description: This property defaults to 0 and is only available for ordinal axes, that is, axes with a band or point scale.

demos.name: TickPosition
demos.description: In the demo below, both axes are set to scaleType='point'.

demos.name: TickLabelPosition
demos.description: In the example below, the top axis is a reference for the default behavior: tick labels don't overflow.

demos.name: OrdinalTickPlacement
demos.description: In the following demo, you can modify the ordinalTimeTicks based on built-in frequencies and see how it impacts zoom behavior.

demos.name: CustomTickFrequency
demos.description: In the following demo, we use the tickFrequencies to display quarters and weeks with different labels.
